title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00040 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 00:15: R/d cutting machine
00:15 - 00:45: L/o upper pup and splash zone joint pulled riser
00:45 - 01:15: R/u cutting machine cut riser. Significant wave height 1 m. R/d cutting machine
01:15 - 01:45: L/o riser joint Pulled riser cleaned off marine growth on centralizer deck. Riser out of splash zone at 01 45
01:45 - 02:15: R/u cutting machine cut riser r/d cutting machine
02:15 - 02:45: L/o riser joint Pulled riser cleaned off marine growth on centralizer deck.
02:45 - 03:15: R/u cutting machine cut riser r/d cutting machine
03:15 - 03:45: L/o riser joint Pulled riser cleaned off marine growth on centralizer deck.
03:45 - 04:30: R/u cutting machine cut riser r/d cutting machine
04:30 - 05:15: L/o riser joint Pulled out with lower pup joint and stress joint Installed master bushing. L/o lower pup and stress joint.
05:15 - 05:30: Cleaned and cleared drill floor for excess equipment.
05:30 - 07:45: Cleared WH decks for excess equipment. Meanwhile performed skidding checks.
07:45 - 08:15: Installed hatch in moonpool end of report
